dct_title_s: Snow Cover (Normalized Difference Snow Index), NOAA-21 / VIIRS
dct_description_sm: A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), available from 2026-09-21 and updated as new data arrive. Made from VIIRS/JPSS2 Snow Cover 6-Min L2 Swath 375m NRT (VJ210_NRT, version 2, doi:10.5067/VIIRS/VJ210_NRT.002).

The VJ210_NRT is Near Real Time (NRT) VIIRS/JPSS2 Snow Cover 6-Min L2 Swath 375m data set which reports the location of snow cover using radiance data acquired by the Visible Infrared Imager Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) on board the NOAA-21 - formerly the Joint Polar Satellite System-2 (JPSS-2) satellite. Snow cover is identified using the Normalized Difference Snow Index (NDSI) and a series of quality control screens. The VJ210_NRT product is provided in NETCDF format. More information can be found from NASA [Snow Cover Products](https://viirsland.gsfc.nasa.gov/Products/NASA/SnowESDR.html) at VIIRS Land website.
